purpose: Defines the code review criteria: which delegated SSOT documents to check by priority, the check order, and the rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip recommendations.
summary: Header stating the SoT is the review priorities spec and that severity comes from delegated principles
SSOT reference table listing P1/P2/P3 delegated documents for code review
P1 sources: project rules via query-db-rules, related design docs, deterministic generation spec
P2 consistency check between design docs and target code
P3 unnecessary complexity check via the anti-patterns document
Check order for P1 rule match, P2 contradictions, P3 complexity
Judgment rules table for fix, create_issue and skip recommendations
Three conditions required for create_issue: no existing rule, recurrence or objectivity, writable granularity
Fallback to built-in rules when delegated rules are missing
tasks: Reviewing code against project rules and design documents
Building a review packet for code review
Deciding the recommendation (fix, create_issue, skip) for a code review finding
Deciding whether a finding qualifies for an issue
Editing or maintaining the code review criteria
